88.bash实现动态进度条
 
89. 根据文件内容创建账号
 
for i in `seq 1 10`
do
    array[$i]=$RANDOM
done
echo -e "Array_1:  ${array[@]}"
for (( x=1;x<=9;x++ ))
do
    for(( y=1;y<=9;y++ ))
    do
        if [ ${array[$y]} -gt ${array[$y+1]} ]
        then
            temp=${array[$y]}
            array[$y]=${array[$y+1]}
            array[$y+1]=$temp
        fi
    done
done
echo -e "Array_2:  ${array[@]}"
#!/bin/bash
i=0
bar=''
index=0
arr=( "|" "/" "-" "\\" )
while [ $i -le 100 ]
do
    let index=index%4
    printf "[%-100s][%d%%][\e[43;46;1m%c\e[0m]\r" "$bar" "$i" "${arr[$index]}"
    let i++
    let index++
    usleep 30000
    bar+='#'
    clear
done
printf "\n"
#!/bin/bash
